disclosure: The saved project record attributes these labels to a separate AI session using frozen page excerpts. The model and session identities were not recorded. The record says agent answers were not shown, but this was not independently verified; exclusion of earlier chat labels is also unverified. Coverage is reported separately over all sampled and scoreable rows. Gold-unscoreable rows remain distinct from agent abstentions on scoreable rows.

rule_scored_fields.verdict: Buildability is derived from the gold fields, not hand-labelled. 1) If gold auth, gold credential_gate, or gold api_surface is not "found", verdict = unknown; an excerpt that does not discuss credential access cannot prove a paid or gated path. 2) Else if the gold credential text names a partner/sales/contact gate, verdict = partner_outreach. 3) Else if the gold api_surface names only a wrapper or CLI, verdict = wrapper_or_cli. 4) Else if the gold credential text names a self-serve free or trial path AND the gold api breadth is broad or moderate, verdict = documented_build_candidate. 5) If self-serve is found but breadth is not stated, verdict = unknown; missing breadth is not evidence of an access gate. 6) Else a paid, approval or partner gate with no self-serve path yields gated_build_candidate; if the excerpt does not establish one of these outcomes, verdict = unknown.

rubric.scoreable_coverage: For the four judgment fields, answered / rows with gold_status="found"; not_stated_in_docs and unresolved rows are gold-unscoreable and excluded. For the two rule fields, all sampled rows are scoreable by convention: Composio toolkit status comes from the saved catalog snapshot and verdict is rule-derived.
rubric.interval: Wilson 95% interval for integer-success proportions only; no interval is reported for fractional half-credit.
rubric.missing: abstained = the pass made no claim; unresolved = the gold excerpt did not state the answer.
